title: Qor qoploni sher kabi o'kira olmaydi

scenes.text: Sher va yo'lbarsdan farqli o'laroq, u xirillaydi va pishillaydi.
U O'rta Osiyoning baland tog'larida, jumladan O'zbekistonda ham yashaydi.
Tog'lar sohibi, lekin bir marta ham o'kirmaydi.

description: Qor qoploni yirik mushuk bo'lsa ham, sher va yo'lbars kabi o'kira olmaydi. U O'rta Osiyo tog'larida, jumladan O'zbekistonda ham uchraydi.
source: https://snowleopard.org/snow-leopard-facts/behavior/ (cannot roar; chuff, hiss, growl); https://publicera.kb.se/slr/article/view/63881 (Snow Leopard Reports: status in Uzbekistan, Western Tien Shan and Gissar range); https://gov.uz/en/eco/news/view/189841 (camera trap in Gissar State Reserve)
